# GitHub publication settings

Applied to [al-siv/update-dsh](https://github.com/al-siv/update-dsh) on 2026-09-15.

**Repository name:** `update-dsh`

**Visibility:** public

**Description:** Update dsh (DeepSeek Harness) to npm latest. Check versions and verify global npm updates with a small Bash script.

**Topics:**

```text
update-dsh
dsh
deepseek
deepseek-harness

npm
bash
```

Keep these values in sync with the repository's About/settings. A file in Git
does not apply the description or topics automatically.

The README answers "how to update dsh" immediately. It names DeepSeek Harness
and the exact npm package to disambiguate `dsh`, and covers global npm installs
and npx separately.

Topics support discovery within GitHub ([GitHub documentation](https://docs.github.com/articles/classifying-your-repository-with-topics)).
Search-engine indexing and ranking can only be assessed after publication;
these settings do not guarantee placement.
